comment: Split map for issue #29, read by tools/split/apply_split.py. For each god file: the new files and the top-level definitions they receive (exact names first, then the first matching pattern), plus names that stay in the god file on purpose (remainder). A file entry may carry a short group label for its commit subject. A definition that no entry names stays where it is and is reported. File-scope data, prototypes, macros and types written in the god file, and static helpers whose users move, are not listed: they follow the code that uses them. A static helper whose users all stay is named in the remainder.

files.description: Virtual Hub packet forwarding, the parts outside the StorePacket unit: the hub packet adapter, the broadcast storm list, and the packet checks that StorePacket calls (management target, logged packets per minute, IPv6 router advertisement, traffic limiter)
Virtual Hub tables: user list cache, IP access control list, CRL, access list, trusted certificates, MAC and IP tables
Virtual Hub options: admin options (the exported admin_options array), the hub option field table, hub message and log settings

remainder.description: Virtual Hub lifecycle: create, online and offline, sessions, watchdog, hub list, hub addresses, hub counters and the hub database, plus the table and option helpers that NewHub and CleanupHub reach through file-local symbols; and the StorePacket unit (StorePacket with its policy, access list and traffic-limiter filters, the URL redirect, the IP table insert and the broadcast storm check): file-local helpers tie these 31 functions into one unit spread over the file, and git diff (myers, as the move-only checker runs it) does not show its move as deletions only

files.description: Sockets: socket events and cancel objects, select, UDP, TCP connect and bind, listen, send and receive buffering, timeouts, socket information and buffer sizes
TLS: the server SSL context, SSL context sharing and the cipher list, Recv and Send with the TLS record send and receive behind them, and the SNI parser
DNS wrappers: the machine name, the reverse host name lookup and the NetBIOS name query

remainder.description: network init and free and every group their file-local state ties to them (TCP connection counter with NewSock, CleanupSock, Accept and Disconnect; the accept host-name switch; the per-source IP client list; the chain certificate cache; the DH parameter with NewSSLCtx; the root-certificate store with the TLS handshake StartSSLEx3, StartSSLServer and StartSSLMain; the host IP address cache; the local MAC list), plus NIC lists, IPv6 support, the host IP address list and the private IP file

files.description: Windows service control: service arguments, SCM install, update, uninstall, start, stop and query, event log
Windows network adapters and network configuration: adapter list, net-class table, firewall registration
Windows processes and tokens: thread priority, process arguments, logon check
Windows system information: VM detection, user locale, computer name, console width

remainder.description: module state (ms) and every function that uses it: module init and free, process-wide setup, service host and user mode, temporary and special directories, privileges and the admin check

files.description: Memory allocation: Malloc, ReAlloc, Free, memory tags, the internal allocator and the canary

remainder.description: containers that Mayaqua keeps (hash list, stack, queue, list, int lists, FIFO, BUF, with BUF dump and file I/O) and the memory utilities (Clone, Copy, Move, Cmp, Zero, IsZero, SearchBin, compression, Base64, EndianUnicode and the little-endian check)

files.description: Pack over HTTP for the SE-VPN protocol (HttpClientSend, HttpClientRecv(Ex), HttpServerSend, HttpServerRecv with its NOOP handling) and the decoy web page that a plain HTTP client gets (HttpSendDecoyPage); one file because both build their reply header with the file-local NewHttpHeaderKeepAlive

remainder.description: generic HTTP message layer: HTTP_HEADER and HTTP_VALUE, header formatting and sending (HttpHeaderToStr, SendHttpHeader, PostHttp), header parsing over a line source (HttpParseHeaderLines with the SOCK and BUF line sources, RecvLine behind the SOCK one, RecvHttpHeader); used by Proxy.c CONNECT, Cedar, vpntest and fuzz_http

files.description: Packet parser core: ParsePacket and the L2 to L4 parse stages, clone and free of a parsed packet, VLAN tag insert and remove; with the DNS, HTTP log and DHCP hooks of ParsePacketEx5, and DhcpModify, which shares the DHCP option helpers DhcpOptionsOf and DhcpMessageType with ParsePacketEx5
Internet checksums: the one's-complement sum, IpChecksum, the IPv4 and IPv6 pseudo-header checksums and the checksum correction of a parsed packet (offload fix-up)
IPv6: the IPv6 header and extension header parse, ICMPv6 and its options (parse, clone, free) and the Neighbor Solicitation builder
DHCP: the DHCP packet test for a client MAC address, the option list parse, lookup and free, and the IPv4 DHCP rewrite (DhcpModifyIPv4)
Layer 7 sniffing for the packet log: the HTTP request and the HTTPS server name (SNI) of the first data segment of a TCP connection

remainder.description: TCP MSS clamping of L2 frames and L3 packets, and the IP header size it reads
